jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Maverick Indonesia is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to support business decisions. You will work closely with marketing and product teams to derive actionable insights from customer data.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or related field
2+ years of experience in data analysis
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Excel
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders
responsibilities: Collect and analyze data from various sources
Develop dashboards and reports for stakeholders
Identify trends and patterns in customer behavior
Create data visualizations to communicate insights
jobs.how_to_apply: Kirim lamaran melalui email ke hr@maverick-indonesia.com

jobs.title: Data Analyst / Data Engineer
jobs.description: SCG Indonesia is looking for a Data Analyst / Data Engineer to support their data-driven decision making. You will be responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to support business intelligence initiatives across the organization.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
3+ years of experience in data analysis or data engineering
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data visualization tools
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
responsibilities: Develop ETL processes for data integration
Create and maintain data models and reports
Support business intelligence and reporting initiatives
jobs.how_to_apply: Kirim lamaran melalui portal karyawan SCG

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Fore Coffee is seeking a QA Automation Engineer to join our quality assurance team. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining automated test scripts to ensure the quality of our software applications.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
2+ years of experience in QA automation
Proficiency in Python and Selenium
Knowledge of API testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
responsibilities: Develop and maintain automated test scripts
Execute manual and automated test cases
Collaborate with developers to fix bugs
Ensure test coverage of all application features
jobs.how_to_apply: Kirim lamaran melalui email ke recruitment@forecoffee.co
